details:
Project Title
EARTH DANCE – Dancing with the SAR

Project Summary
EARTH DANCE is an interactive educational website about Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) technology. It explains how radar satellites observe Earth in all weather conditions, day and night. It explores the NISAR mission, flood monitoring, forests, agriculture and Earth deformation through interactive maps, satellite galleries and data visualization.

Project Description
EARTH DANCE aims to make SAR technology easier to understand through visual explanations and interactive learning. The website introduces radar imaging, explains how different surfaces reflect radar signals, and demonstrates its applications in environmental monitoring. It also features the NISAR mission, satellite information, an interactive Earth map and SAR data visualization. The project connects satellite science with real-world challenges and shows how radar technology helps us understand our changing planet.

Project Category: Earth and Environment
